facts.text: Pre-registration means recording, before data exist, exactly what will be claimed, how it will be measured, which samples will be used and when testing will stop, to prevent analysis from being bent to fit results.
facts.quote: Pre-registration means writing down, before the data exist, exactly what will be claimed, how it will be measured, which samples will be used and when testing will stop, so that the analysis cannot be bent to fit the results.

facts.text: For braking-system pre-registration, acceptance criteria, strata, confidence levels and stopping rules are fixed in the test plan before hardware arrives.
facts.quote: Acceptance criteria, strata, confidence levels and stopping rules are fixed in the test plan before the hardware arrives.

facts.text: For braking-system pre-registration, the estimation sample is drawn before tuning starts, using a fixed random seed and a content hash to prevent cases from being quietly swapped.
facts.quote: The estimation sample is drawn before tuning starts, with a fixed random seed and a content hash so that nobody can quietly swap cases.

facts.text: For braking-system pre-registration, weighting and estimators are frozen before any results are inspected.
facts.quote: The weighting and the estimators are frozen before any results are inspected.

facts.text: Chapter 10 recommends establishing pre-registered acceptance criteria during the braking-system program's pre-hardware work.
facts.quote: Chapter 10 adds pre-registered acceptance criteria to the pre-hardware work

facts.text: Chapter 12 recommends predicting a braking-system pilot blind against pre-registered criteria.
facts.quote: Chapter 12 asks that a pilot be predicted blind against pre-registered criteria

facts.text: Chapter 13 recommends judging the sensor-model correlation pilot against pre-registered metrics.
facts.quote: Chapter 13 asks that the sensor-model correlation pilot be judged against pre-registered metrics

facts.text: If sensor types are decided after strata and sample sizes have been frozen, sensor-physics-dependent strata for dust, glare and rain must be re-derived and the frozen sample redrawn, costing calendar time within the validation window.
facts.quote: If the sensor types are decided late, after the strata and sample sizes are frozen, the strata that depend on sensor physics (dust, glare, rain) must be re-derived and the frozen sample redrawn, which costs calendar time inside the window

facts.text: A pre-registered braking-system test plan enables an outside assessor to trust results produced under schedule pressure.
facts.quote: A pre-registered plan is what allows an outside assessor to believe a result produced under schedule pressure.

facts.text: Pre-registration is the braking-system program's main protection against quiet forms of over-fitting.
facts.quote: It is also the main protection against the quiet forms of over-fitting
